title: Practical judgement
learning_outcomes: Explain rules and judgement in the context of practical judgement.
Compare and distinguish conflicting duties in the context of practical judgement.
Apply proportionality in the context of practical judgement.
Evaluate and justify decisions about consequences in the context of practical judgement.

lessons.title: Rules and judgement
lessons.outcome: Explain rules and judgement in the context of practical judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving rules and judgement; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to judgement case portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain rules and judgement from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of rules and judgement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Conflicting duties
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish conflicting duties in the context of practical judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving conflicting duties; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to judgement case portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain conflicting duties from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of conflicting duties; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Proportionality
lessons.outcome: Apply proportionality in the context of practical judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving proportionality; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to judgement case portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain proportionality from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of proportionality; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Consequences
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about consequences in the context of practical judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving consequences; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to judgement case portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain consequences from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of consequences; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of rules and judgement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of conflicting duties; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of proportionality; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of consequences; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
